description_en: Parses video shots by splitting an input video at shot boundaries and returns the split points
description_zh: 镜头解析，对输入的视频按镜头进行切分，返回切分点
name: DetectVideoShot

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is not in the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url
